description: This file defines the IoTFleetHubClient class which extends AwsClient, used for interacting with AWS IoT Fleet Hub service. It includes method annotations for various operations like create, delete, describe applications, and managing tags, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: IoTFleetHubClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS IoT Fleet Hub service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: createApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: deleteApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: describeApplication
methods.description: Describes details of an IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: describeApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes details of an IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all IoT Fleet Hub applications.

methods.name: listApplicationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all IoT Fleet Hub applications.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateApplication
methods.description: Updates details of an IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: updateApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates details of an IoT Fleet Hub application.
